checks.name: A real ME1 purchase, equipped item, named manual save and entry checkpoint stay independent from every Chronicle and documentary action
Twenty-four exact work-scoped generated illustrations really decode and render through documentary UI with bounded clipped cells; NPC and fleet overlays grant no combat or gameplay permission
Eight exact weapon models use real heat, interruptible charge or charge-then-flight systems with finite resource expenditure and preparation save/import/reload
Fourteen edition armor presets require their explicit prepared edition workshop and protagonist; Remnant remains a bounded Ryder-only aggregate
Ultralight changes an actual Overload cooldown from 8 to 7.2 seconds once; power damage, weapon resources and finite grenade behavior remain unchanged after real save/import/reload
Six contextual opposition benches run sixteen source-identified enemies and three partial bosses through native attacks, six real victories and strict saved outcomes
